work_item: Goal-related bounded projection for the ordinary AskPreviousRelation Core route

scope.selection: Resolve only prior committed ResultRecord Fact dependency IDs inside a revision-matched Store relation-index transaction; then project the resolved Goal relation, applicable Facts/Rules, Rule premise closure, condition evidence and transitive proof dependencies.
scope.ownership: Store supplies revision-checked derived records. Existing Core owns context interpretation, condition/proof evaluation, stop behavior, answer construction and adoption; no new decision authority was added.
scope.budget: Distinct prior dependency-ID lookups, Goal projection and proof evaluation share the sealed relation action budget.
scope.index_fallback: A missing legacy index is rebuilt once from the authenticated loaded current memory snapshot. That cold-index whole-snapshot read remains; if a concurrent writer advances the head during rebuild, this request retains the loaded immutable full-snapshot fallback.
scope.recovery: Recovery replays against the recorded immutable full memory revision and checks current proof validity. B59 does not wire every Recovery or relation-list consumer through the Goal selector.
